LanguageData.BOR_CommuneDesc: Commune with dark archotech for knowledge about {0}.
LanguageData.BOR_CommuneConfirm: Are you sure? A bolt of lightning will strike {0}, who will fall deathly ill with the dark archotech commune. Whether they build immunity in time or die of it, the knowledge about {1} is gained.
LanguageData.BOR_CommuneInProgress: Someone is already communing for this knowledge.
LanguageData.BOR_CommuneCured: The dark archotech commune in {0} was cut short by outside treatment. The dark archotechs gave nothing: the knowledge about {1} was not gained, and the ritual can be tried again.
